role: Platform Lead / Program Director, Consumer Self-Service Channels

note: Posting closed before submission. Pack built and kept — role may still be live; a direct approach is the remaining option.

Triaged with --score-only; no pack built. Do not read the 77% as a signal — the posting yielded only 20 terms and no competency theme survived, so a short JD scores high by having little to miss. Skipped on three structural grounds: the bar is set at '5+ years of experience in digital leadership roles', which bands the role for someone eight to twelve years in; it is a marketing role rather than a product or platform one (Digital Marketing degree, data-driven marketing, brand consistency, Marketing among the four teams it leads); and 'experience with large-scale CMS and personalization tools' (AEM, Sitecore, Optimizely) sits under Requirements, with nothing in the profile evidencing any martech stack. The overlap is real — digital experience roadmap, leading UI/UX, frontend, product and marketing, engagement and conversion KPIs, and 'user journey optimization' is the PropertyGuru +20% conversion line — but it is a sideways move, not an upward one.
